name: Heartbreaker
source:
Will you fall in love—or drive him to his doom?

As the villainous Heartbreaker, the beachside city of Damsel is your playground…or it would be if those four handsome heroes didn’t foil your nefarious ambitions at every turn.

You’ve certainly lost your fair share of battles to the Heroes Alliance. Perseverance, their no-nonsense leader, would like nothing more than to see you behind bars. The mysterious archer Eclipse seems to take you a little less seriously, but remains a formidable threat with his duo powers. Meanwhile, pompous shapeshifter The Beast seems more concerned with life as a celebrity than stopping crime. Even that newcomer Hammerhead has given you grief on occasion with his malfunctioning inventions and sheer desperation to prove himself.

Still: Losing battle after battle as Heartbreaker is better than going to work each day to barely afford rent. Right?

However, that’s all about to change one day when you hop aboard the lovely cruise ship Junonia, the wind in your hair, and a powerful diamond ring in your pocket…
translation:
你会爱上他，还是把他推向灭亡？

作为邪恶的伤心者，海滨城市达姆瑟尔就是你的游乐场……或者如果这四位英俊的英雄没有每次都挫败你的邪恶野心的话，这将会是你的游乐场。

你确实在英雄联盟的战斗中输掉了应有的份额。毅力，他们严肃的领袖，最希望看到你被关进监狱。神秘的弓箭手日蚀似乎不太重视你，但他的双重力量仍然是一个强大的威胁。与此同时，浮夸的变形者“野兽”似乎更关心名人的生活，而不是阻止犯罪。即使是新来的锤头鲨有时也会因为他的发明故障和对证明自己的绝望而给你带来悲伤。

尽管如此：《伤心欲绝》的一场场战斗都失败了，也比每天为了勉强付房租而工作要好。正确的？

然而，有一天，当你登上可爱的朱诺尼亚号游轮，风吹过你的头发，口袋里装着一枚强大的钻戒时，一切都将发生改变……
